subject: vt-u-pt
title: VT.U.PT.------C.CONT.
description: Diagram in AF(D)-35 (Affinity Dynamics, Level One) opening Braxton's section on dis-unification: 'the most basic resultant that has developed through information compression has been the multi-levels of dis-unification between people (regardless of nationality or affinity nature) — and as a result, non-functionalism.' (C)VT-U-PT (the concept of vibrational universe particulars) is crossed with C-CONT (composite continuance): the question is what vibrational-universe-particulars produces when crossed with composite-continuance — under conditions where dis-unification has produced non-functionalism. HI-P (high purpose), PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics), and C-CONT cluster in the upper register. MT-INFO (multi-information) and PRI-INFO (principle information) anchor the upper-right output. COS-P (cosmic particulars) and WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) feed in from the lower-left. IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) sits centrally. MTA-RT-SIGN (meta-reality significance) hangs on the lower-right margin. T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) anchors the lower-center. Structural argument: vibrational-universe-particulars crossed with composite-continuance is mediated by infra-structure-dynamics — exposing Braxton's structural diagnostic that under dis-unification, even the most fundamental vibrational orientation gets routed through *style-dynamics* rather than substance. The doubled upstreams (cosmic-particulars plus world-expansion-principle on one side, time-continuum-implications on the other) are what hold the crossing together — when those fail, composite-continuance collapses into multi-information-as-data without meta-reality-significance, which is exactly the non-functionalism Braxton describes.
